base_prompt:
GAME TITLE LOGO, wide landscape (about 3:1), transparent background (real alpha channel), no other text, no watermark, nothing cropped, centered with a little padding.
The logo must spell EXACTLY this text, character for character, in English: Coal-or-Gift   (that is: C-o-a-l, hyphen, o-r, hyphen, G-i-f-t; keep the two hyphens). Check the spelling carefully; it is a single line.
ART STYLE: match the attached reference's Korean messenger-sticker / casual-mobile-game look: chunky rounded bubble letters, thick uniform dark outline, flat colors with at most one soft shade tone, cute and playful, funny Christmas mood. Big and bold, readable at small sizes.

jobs.name: logo_a
jobs.prompt: Letter design: the word 'Coal' is made of black rocky coal-lump letters with glowing orange ember cracks and a few small snow caps on top; 'or' is smaller, in white with a red outline, sitting between two small hyphens; the word 'Gift' is bright red like wrapped presents with a gold ribbon cross over the letters and a little gold bow on top of the G. The two big words are the same height.

jobs.name: logo_b
jobs.prompt: Letter design: 'Coal' in dark charcoal-grey puffy letters with orange sparks, 'Gift' in shiny candy-red letters with white polka dots and a green-and-gold ribbon; the small 'or' in the middle is on a little golden star badge; hyphens drawn as candy-cane segments. Snow piled on the tops of the letters. Slightly bouncy baseline (letters gently jumping).

jobs.name: logo_c
jobs.prompt: Letter design: both big words in the same chunky bubble style: 'Coal' black with a faint ember glow, 'Gift' red-and-white striped like a candy cane; small 'or' in gold; hyphens as small gold ribbons. A tiny black lump of coal and a tiny red gift box are tucked in front of the letters at the bottom corners. Snow dusting on the tops.
